pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.
   D. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

3. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.
   C. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon.
   C. Say Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.
   B. Use Bible Study Methods Devotional Method to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Study Methods Devotional Method has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain General Epistle: James and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain : 1Peter Selected teachings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
